description: Receipt-grounded developmental capability DAG with a persistent self-directed learning plan, non-scalar Pareto experiment selection, order-N metacognitive plan revision, explicit evidence budgets, causally grounded structural-surprise signals, generic order-N Goal wiring, per-effector consequence subgoals, renewable surprise/time-triggered process leases, capability-keyed delayed retention, and verified similar-morphology transfer.

rules.name: ed_instantiate_capability_in_situated_body
rules.comment: Instantiate each ability hypothesis under the currently sensed body relation system; templates carry no output authority.

rules.name: ed_instantiate_self_directed_learning_plan
rules.comment: The learner owns a persistent plan over capability hypotheses. Its decisions, budgets, revisions, and outcomes remain graph state; the developmental DAG supplies constraints, not an externally authored schedule.

rules.name: ed_plan_every_situated_capability_hypothesis
rules.comment: Every situated capability becomes a revisable plan step. Its initial evidence budget is derived from the body's evidence window plus its relational prerequisite depth.

rules.name: ed_wire_each_learning_step_to_generic_goal_cognition
rules.comment: The developmental plan does not invent a second goal ontology. Each step pursues the existing generic Goal node used by the rest of cognition.

rules.name: ed_decompose_effector_discovery_into_observed_channel_goals
rules.comment: Each discovered body channel is a genuine Goal child. This exposes incremental causal learning to generic order-N supervision without rewarding repeated motion.

rules.name: ed_learning_plan_selects_pareto_frontier_experiment
rules.comment: The plan selects only after every ready step has a complete, non-scalar Pareto point. Ordinal resolves genuinely incomparable frontier ties; it is not an objective weighting.

rules.name: ed_archive_completed_learning_decision_candidate
rules.comment: Completed Pareto alternatives remain auditable graph history but leave the generic hot comparison edge, preventing past planning epochs from consuming present cognition budget.

rules.name: ed_publish_structural_envelope_departure_to_process_supervisor
rules.comment: A failed experiment is evidence, not automatically surprise. Only body destruction or the structural-limit faculty's explicit interrupt leaves the held expected envelope.

rules.name: ed_release_dominated_process_for_checkin_replanning
rules.comment: The general cognitive supervisor has withdrawn continuation authority. Release this embodied experiment so the ordinary Pareto planner, not the host, can select another basin.

rules.name: ed_reopen_process_released_capability_when_authority_returns
rules.comment: The supervisor's withdrawal of continuation authority is what suspended this capability; when that withdrawal is over the suspension has no premise left and the capability returns to the frontier. Whether to select it again is the planner's decision.

rules.name: ed_detect_situated_configuration_reversal
rules.comment: A reversal is an observed return through the same coarse proprioceptive regions, not exact pose equality, an assumed opposite actuator, or a canonical configuration.

rules.name: ed_recall_exact_body_partial_experience_without_mastery
rules.comment: Exact-body experience restores evidence, not authority. A pending retention state still needs a fresh successful receipt.

rules.name: ed_recall_exact_body_metacognitive_plan_revision
rules.comment: An exact-shape plan counterexample warm-starts allocation but remains conditional: mastering the redirect target reopens the suspended experiment.

rules.name: ed_recall_exact_body_capability_for_local_reverification
rules.comment: An exact structural body can reopen a retained ability at the verification boundary. Recall has zero output authority and requires a fresh successful receipt before mastery is restored.

rules.name: ed_warm_start_capability_from_similar_body_shape
rules.comment: Initialization-time shape recall must settle before the first receipt makes attempt_count nonzero; background starvation would permanently erase an otherwise valid prior. Transfer only an output-null capability/search prior when shared morphology motifs outnumber the residual. The new body must still earn a complete local competence and delayed-retention window.

rules.name: ed_retain_every_causally_closed_developmental_experience
rules.comment: Closure proves that the command and consequence belong to one receipt. It does not imply success, safety, or replay authority; adverse tails remain first-class learned evidence.

rules.name: ed_mark_destroyed_embodiment_terminal_after_retention
rules.comment: Destruction terminates the current embodiment, not the learner. The causal receipt must already be durable before this state transition can occur.

rules.name: ed_request_reinstantiation_from_retained_terminal_receipt
rules.comment: The graph owns the decision to iterate. The environment adapter only enacts this explicit request. Replacement cost remains observable evidence rather than becoming a categorical prohibition.

rules.name: ed_request_new_situated_experiment_after_failure_window
rules.comment: A reset is also an epistemic action. After a complete body-derived evidence window adds no successful evidence, the graph may spend replacement cost to sample a different situated basin.

rules.name: ed_select_reinstantiation_scenario_for_active_frontier
rules.comment: Curiosity selects among interface-declared initial conditions that can expose the active capability. Reuse count is an integer exploration cost; the selected condition is one component of a graph-authored reset act.

rules.name: ed_revise_learning_plan_budget_after_scenario_change
rules.comment: A graph-authored body/scenario replacement is a plan revision. It opens one more body-derived evidence window without erasing the evidence already spent.

rules.name: ed_continue_learning_in_reinstantiated_embodiment
rules.comment: A reset advances the situated embodiment generation. Only body-local terminal state is cleared; learned graph structure and the destructive receipt remain intact.

rules.name: ed_note_developmental_receipt_skipped_for_want_of_measurement
rules.comment: An unmeasured trial is not a failed trial. It is counted here, separately, so a channel that is written by nothing is visible as such instead of accumulating fabricated failures.

rules.name: ed_extend_learning_budget_only_from_observed_progress
rules.comment: Budget exhaustion is a planning event. A step earns another body-derived evidence window only when the exhausted window contained new successful evidence; this is an explicit revision, not an unbounded retry loop.

rules.name: ed_defer_exhausted_learning_step_without_progress_or_reset
rules.comment: When no new success was observed and the environment cannot instantiate another experiment, the plan records an honest deferment instead of silently retrying forever.

rules.name: ed_derive_body_receipt_window_from_morphology
rules.comment: The receipt window is read off the body's actuated degrees of freedom — the number of distinct ways the body could have produced the milestone observation. Body-derived, as its consumer requires, and carried with its provenance so a derived window is never confusable with an assumed one. A body that declares no degrees of freedom leaves the window ABSENT rather than 0.

rules.name: ed_open_delayed_retention_test_after_varied_competence
rules.comment: A single milestone event is not competence. Require a body-derived receipt window and more successful contexts than the number of prerequisite capabilities before opening retention. The window is DECLARED-OR-REFUSE: with no window derived for this body the gate does not open at all, because a window written by nothing used to coalesce to 0 through the `+0` idiom and made both evidence guards pass unconditionally -- this comment described a check the code did not perform.

rules.name: ed_release_incomplete_experiment_back_to_frontier
rules.comment: One action has one active developmental question. After its receipt, return an incomplete ability to the shared curiosity frontier so concurrently learnable abilities can interleave.

rules.name: ed_store_partial_capability_experience_at_lifetime_boundary
rules.comment: Consolidate unfinished evidence rather than forcing each fresh embodiment to repeat it. This memory is output-null and is never itself evidence of mastery.

rules.name: ed_store_metacognitive_plan_revision_at_lifetime_boundary
rules.comment: Retain a verified plan counterexample by exact body shape. The memory is output-null: recall changes experiment allocation, never actuator authority or competence evidence.

rules.name: ed_retain_highest_metacognitive_policy_order_at_lifetime_boundary
rules.comment: Retain reflective practice as the highest demonstrated policy order for this exact body and plan counterexample.

rules.name: ed_store_failed_learning_revision_with_mastery_context
rules.comment: A failed revision is retained as a contextual negative result, not a permanent blacklist. Its relational mastery frontier defines when the counterexample is applicable.

rules.name: ed_record_unstorable_mastery_memory_for_want_of_a_body_key
rules.comment: A mastered capability whose episode declares no body capability signature cannot be stored as a shape-addressed memory. The refusal is recorded on the instance rather than dropped, so an absent cross-body transfer is legible as a stated gap instead of looking like a capability that was never mastered.
effects: episode declares no body_capability_signature to key the memory by

rules.name: ed_mark_exercised_effector_affordance
rules.comment: An affordance is EXERCISED when some candidate modelling it has grounded experience. `experience_units` is incremented only against grounded evidence, so this reads real trials rather than proposals. Unconditional and a pure function of the candidate set, so re-firing rewrites the same flag.

rules.name: ed_count_effector_survey_coverage
rules.comment: Declared and covered effector counts, both read off the body. UNCONDITIONAL by necessity: `Count`/`Sum` over `Neighbours` evaluate to their identity inside a `where` while being correct in an effect, measured in this tree, so the aggregation cannot be guarded on its own value.

rules.name: ed_assert_effector_survey_complete_only_against_a_declared_body
rules.comment: Completeness is asserted ONLY against a body that declares a positive number of effectors. An absent or zero declared count makes `covered >= declared` trivially true, which would read as a fully surveyed body having surveyed nothing -- the free pass this guard exists to refuse. Such a body is recorded UNMEASURABLE, which is a different statement from incomplete.
